title: Bioelectrochemical systems and engineered living materials: a tutorial on carbon capture and sustainable energy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5727-5748
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00344J, Review Article
Graziela C. Sedenho, Guilherme H. S. Ghiraldelli, Rodrigo M. Iost, Ricardo Brito-Pereira, Rita Policia, Senentxu Lanceros-Méndez, Frank N. Crespilho
Bioelectrochemical systems (BESs) and engineered living materials (ELMs) are revolutionizing sustainable energy and carbon management by addressing thermodynamic and kinetic barriers in energy conversion and carbon capture.
